Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the ambiguous search result snippet from DuckDuckGo (which likely showed unrelated content or a misread line) as a definitive credit of "Written-By – Hank Williams" for the song "Turn Me On." This contradicts the well-established fact that the song was written by John D. Loudermilk, as confirmed in earlier search results (Wikipedia, RateYourMusic). Instead of verifying this contradiction by opening the actual Discogs release page to read the specific credits or checking a more reliable source, the Planner proceeded to instruct the WebSurfer to accept "Hank Williams" as the writer, leading to a factually incorrect final answer.
